script: In 1814, London was hit by a flood. But it wasn't rain. It was beer. Inside the Horse Shoe Brewery, a massive wooden vat was holding thousands of barrels of porter. Then one of its iron bands snapped. At first, workers didn't panic. These bands had slipped before. But about an hour later, the entire tank burst. A wall of beer exploded through the brewery, smashed open more vats, and rushed into the streets. Buildings were damaged. Cellars filled instantly. People were trapped before they even understood what was happening. This wasn't a funny accident. It was an industrial disaster. Eight people died. And somehow, the brewery was later cleared of responsibility. London hadn't been hit by a storm. It had been flooded by beer.
title: The Great Emu War
